A silver coin tossed on black velvet deep
It watches while the weary world dreams by

No cloud can hide its pale and steady eye
The stars lean close to hear the secrets keep
The moon climbs up the silent evening sky

Owls call aloud as night birds fly
Ancient light wakes what shadows sleep
It watches while the weary world dreams by

Tides answer to its pull, the oceans sigh
Each wave a whisper, each crest a leap
The moon climbs up the silent evening sky

Lovers walk beneath its glow, shy
Promises made that only night can keep
It watches while the weary world dreams by

Dawn steals the stage, the night must say goodbye
But tomorrow darkness comes again to reap
The moon climbs up the silent evening sky
It watches while the weary world dreams by
